recommendations.issue: Inconsistent food quality and potentially low-quality ingredients.
recommendations.action: Implement a comprehensive kitchen audit: review all recipes for clarity and consistency, conduct blind taste tests, source higher-quality ingredients from new or existing suppliers, and provide refresher training on preparation standards to all kitchen staff.
recommendations.expected_impact: Significant improvement in customer satisfaction with food taste and quality, leading to repeat business and positive reviews.

recommendations.issue: Poor staff attitude and service, potentially due to training gaps, understaffing, or management issues.
recommendations.action: Implement mandatory customer service training focusing on empathy, conflict resolution, and proactive service. Review staffing levels during peak hours and ensure adequate supervision and support for front-of-house staff to reduce stress.
recommendations.expected_impact: Enhanced customer experience, reduced negative feedback on staff interactions, and improved staff morale.

recommendations.issue: Perceived poor value for money or uncompetitive pricing.
recommendations.action: Conduct a competitive pricing analysis of similar restaurants in the area. Evaluate menu items for cost-effectiveness and perceived value, considering options for value-added bundles or slightly adjusting prices where justified by quality improvements.
recommendations.expected_impact: Improved customer perception of value, potentially increasing sales and reducing price-related complaints.

recommendations.issue: Excessive wait times for service and food.
recommendations.action: Analyze peak hour operations to identify bottlenecks in kitchen production and front-of-house service. Consider adjusting staff schedules, optimizing kitchen workflow, or implementing a more efficient order management system to streamline operations.
recommendations.expected_impact: Reduced customer wait times, leading to higher satisfaction and improved table turnover.

recommendations.issue: Subpar cleanliness standards across the establishment.
recommendations.action: Establish and enforce a daily, weekly, and monthly cleaning checklist for all areas (dining room, restrooms, kitchen, entrance). Assign specific staff members to cleaning duties and conduct regular spot checks by management.
recommendations.expected_impact: A more pleasant and hygienic dining environment, reducing health concerns and improving overall customer perception.

recommendations.action: Conduct a walk-through audit of the dining area to identify specific issues with decor, lighting, and seating comfort. Prioritize small, cost-effective improvements (e.g., new lighting, rearranging seating, fresh paint) that can quickly enhance the ambiance.
recommendations.expected_impact: A more inviting and comfortable dining experience, encouraging longer stays and repeat visits.
